description: Get user-submitted reviews for a flight, optionally filtered to a specific seat. Shows ratings, comments, seat number, cabin, and helpfulness votes. Free — no auth required.

order.description: Sort order: 'recent' (default) or 'helpful' (most specific and upvoted first)

seat_number.description: Optional seat number to filter reviews (e.g. '12A')

name: get_seat_reviews
title: Get seat reviews
